'''Robb Solter''' is a [[Two Rivers]] man in [[Perrin Aybara]]'s army.

== Activities ==
He is sent to fetch a pavilion for a second parley between Perrin and [[Galadedrid Damodred]] the [[Lord Captain Commander]] of the [[Children of the Light]].

==Trivia==
This character is named after Wheel of Time fan Rob Soelter.<ref>Brandon Sanderson's Twitter, 10 June 2010. [https://twitter.com/BrandSanderson/status/15812215559]</ref>
